meta.one_sentence_pitch_en: A token is a small chunk of text an AI reads or writes, and both input and output tokens count toward usage.
meta.one_sentence_pitch_ko: 토큰은 AI가 읽고 쓰는 작은 글자 조각이고, 넣는 것과 받는 것 둘 다 사용량으로 계산됩니다.
meta.sticky_takeaway_en: Tokens are the meter, not words.
meta.next_episode_teaser_en: Next: how many tokens fit at once.
meta.next_episode_teaser_ko: 다음은 토큰이 한 번에 얼마나 들어가는지예요.

narration.en: You see “1 million token context” and think… cool. But what is a token?
narration.ko: ‘백만 토큰 컨텍스트’라는 말을 보면 멋있어 보이죠. 그런데 토큰이 뭐냐고요?

scenes.visual_intent: Atlas floats in a cozy pixel-art room, staring at a giant glowing headline that reads “1M TOKEN CONTEXT,” with a puzzled face on its CRT screen. The composition centers the intimidating headline above and Atlas below, creating a curious, slightly overwhelmed mood.

narration.en: A token is a small chunk of text. Not exactly a word, but a bite-sized piece the AI counts.
narration.ko: 토큰은 글의 작은 조각입니다. 딱 단어 하나는 아니고, AI가 세는 한입 크기라고 보시면 됩니다.

scenes.visual_intent: A simple pixel-art sentence sits across the screen and breaks into small rectangular tiles, each tile holding a word piece, punctuation mark, or short fragment. The layout is clean and diagram-like, with the tiles spaced to show they are counted units.

narration.en: Sometimes one word is one token. Sometimes one word becomes several. Even punctuation can count.
narration.ko: 어떤 단어는 토큰 하나일 수 있고요. 어떤 단어는 여러 개로 쪼개집니다. 쉼표 같은 기호도 셀 수 있어요.

scenes.visual_intent: Three side-by-side pixel examples show a short word as one tile, a longer word split into multiple tiles, and punctuation shown as its own tiny tile. The mood is clear and lightly playful, like an educational game screen.

narration.en: Think of tokens like a taxi meter. Every bit you send in starts the meter running.
narration.ko: 토큰은 택시 미터기처럼 생각하시면 쉽습니다. 내가 넣는 글부터 바로 요금이 올라가요.

scenes.visual_intent: Atlas drives a small pixel-art taxi labeled “AI,” glancing at a glowing meter on the dashboard as text tiles drop into the cab like passengers. The scene is side-view, cozy and funny, with the meter clicking upward.

narration.en: And every bit the AI sends back keeps it running. Yes, the ride charges both ways.
narration.ko: 그리고 AI가 돌려주는 글도 계속 미터기에 잡힙니다. 네, 이 택시는 왕복 요금입니다.

scenes.visual_intent: The same taxi now has arrows showing text tiles going in and a larger stream of text tiles coming out the other side, while Atlas points at the meter climbing faster. The composition emphasizes two-way flow and a mildly witty mood.

narration.en: Say your prompt uses 120 tokens. That’s your input cost.
narration.ko: 예를 들어 내가 넣은 프롬프트가 120토큰이라면, 그게 입력 비용입니다.

scenes.visual_intent: Atlas feeds a small stack of 120 glowing text tiles into a terminal-like box, while a neat counter flips to “120.” The framing is close enough to make the number feel concrete and easy to read.

narration.en: Then the model replies with 350 tokens. That’s output cost.
narration.ko: 그리고 모델이 350토큰으로 답하면, 그건 출력 비용이고요.

scenes.visual_intent: A much larger stream of glowing text tiles pours out of the terminal toward Atlas, and a second counter lands on “350.” Atlas looks pleased with the long answer, while the visual hints that more output means more counted units.

narration.en: So you’re not paying for just the question. You’re paying for the question and the answer.
narration.ko: 즉, 질문만 계산되는 게 아닙니다. 질문과 답변 둘 다 계산돼요.

scenes.visual_intent: A simple pixel-art receipt appears with two line items: input tokens and output tokens, then a combined total at the bottom. The design is tidy and instantly understandable, like a shop bill in a retro game.

narration.en: That’s why token counts matter for cost, speed, and how much text the AI can handle at once.
narration.ko: 그래서 토큰 수는 비용에도, 속도에도, AI가 한 번에 다룰 수 있는 양에도 중요합니다.

scenes.visual_intent: Three pixel icons appear in a row: a coin stack, a speed gauge, and a container filling with text tiles. Each icon lights up in sequence to show the three practical reasons token counts matter.

narration.en: So when you hear “tokens,” think: the little pieces of language the meter is counting.
narration.ko: 이제 ‘토큰’이라고 들리면, 미터기가 세고 있는 언어 조각이라고 떠올리시면 됩니다.

scenes.visual_intent: Atlas stands beside a large glowing meter while text tiles drift past it one by one, each making the number tick up. The mood is confident and clarifying, like the final answer clicking into place.

narration.en: Next up: if tokens are the pieces, what’s the box that holds them all? Context window.
narration.ko: 다음은 이 조각들을 담는 상자가 뭔지 볼게요. 바로 컨텍스트 윈도우입니다.

scenes.visual_intent: Atlas cheerfully gestures toward a large empty pixel-art container as text tiles hover nearby, ready to be placed inside. The composition feels like a clean handoff into the next episode.
